_doc: The 9 s file with the pause cells in ONE-UTTERANCE mode (plan §5.2, approved 2026-11-20): each thought of a pause cell is synthesised whole and the pause inserted at its word boundary, at the quietest 10 ms within 40 ms of it, with a 15 ms fade each side and the stream's room noise in the gap. Only voices with word times speak there. Flows carry the tag; the piece-by-piece recordings stay as the comparison. 16 flows per pause cell: a thought with a cut that is not clean (energy around it over half the speech's) is left out, so a cell keeps n ≥ 52.

human_pause._measured: Checked against the human profile's es voice pause_between_fragments_ms (n=1643): p50 1744, p90 4993, p99 18251 ms. This log-normal through p50 1700 / p90 5000 matches p50 and p90 within 3 %; its p99 is ~12 s (shorter tail). EN (n=38, low_n) is not used: the profile says to prefer es.

_cells: each pause length is a cell; 300 ms is reported but, per the profile, lives inside a final
